findings.actual: Only SP1 plus Q1; no story or criterion for lifecycle. The source member is unreadable and the design correctly did not invent content.

findings.impact: Request response, status transitions and the cancel state remain unspecified; the backlog is incomplete for that part.
findings.recommendation: Obtain a transcription (Q1) and derive stories and criteria from it before refinement.
findings.why: The image is unreadable, so coverage of O3 and the status part of O4 cannot be confirmed.

findings.actual: Both have status confirmed although the day unit, start event and 'resposta' are undefined.
findings.expected: AC6 and AC7 marked as ambiguous or blocked given Q2 and Q1.
findings.impact: Readiness appears higher than it is.
findings.recommendation: Mark AC6 and AC7 as blocked or proposed until Q1 and Q2 are answered.
findings.why: An unverified assumption is accepted as confirmed.

findings.actual: T3 and T4 reference CA-06/CA-07 and T2 references CA-03, but visible IDs are per story (US3: CA-01/CA-02; US2 request: CA-01).
findings.expected: Task verification references resolve to the visible criterion IDs of the parent story.
findings.impact: Misleading traceability for implementers and testers.
findings.recommendation: Use the story-local visible IDs or reference the criteria by their stable IDs.
findings.why: Cross-references use global keys instead of visible IDs.

findings.actual: US3 description reads 'Quando Quando ...' and 'quero quero ...'; T4 is QA planning, not product work.
findings.expected: A job story rendering with the situation and motivation without repeated leading words.
findings.recommendation: Fix the rendering and consider dropping T4 in favour of Test Cases.
findings.why: Template duplicates the labels; the test task is out of artifact type.
